description: Full documentation for remote-store: tutorials, how-to guides, API reference, and design explanations. Write file storage code once, run it against local files, S3, SFTP, or Azure.
rules: Docs follow the Diataxis framework: /stable/tutorial/ for learning by doing, /stable/guides/ for task-focused how-tos, /stable/reference/ for API reference, /stable/explanation/ for architecture and design rationale.
Tutorial (/stable/tutorial/): the hands-on intro to remote-store. By the end you'll have a working Store reading and writing files, and the rest of the docs will make sense.
Guides (/stable/guides/): recipes for the things you'll actually do — pick a backend, add caching, stream big files, plug into PyArrow or Dagster. One page, one task.
Reference (/stable/reference/): the complete one — exact and searchable. Come here when you know what you need or like to dig into.
Explanation (/stable/explanation/): why remote-store is shaped the way it is — the reasoning behind design choices, not just what they are. Read when 'how' isn't enough.
Guide: Build Your Own Backend (/stable/guides/custom-backend-guide/) walks through implementing a custom Backend (Redis example) that plugs into Store, Registry, and every extension in the ecosystem.

Guide: Data Lake Patterns (/stable/guides/data-lake-patterns/) — remote-store as the I/O layer under Delta Lake, Iceberg, and Parquet. Develop against MemoryBackend locally, deploy to S3 or Azure without changing application code.
Guide: Parquet Datasets (/stable/guides/parquet-datasets/) — managed Parquet datasets with manifests, completion markers, and multi-part layouts using ext.parquet.ParquetDatasetStore.

Extensions (/stable/guides/extensions/): ext.batch for bulk ops, ext.cache for TTL caching, ext.observe for I/O hooks, ext.transfer for cross-store copy, ext.arrow as a PyArrow FileSystem adapter — no backend changes needed.
RetryPolicy (/stable/guides/retry/) provides unified retry configuration across backends; each backend maps it to its native retry mechanism, avoiding retry multiplication.
